scope: all columns in the delivered 37-table PostgreSQL seed, plus cross-store canonical market fields; not a claim that every future production table is implemented

naming_rules.identity: stable *_id; never display names or mutable exchange symbols as PK
naming_rules.units: encode material units in field names; price_raw must travel with currency and adjustment_mode=raw
naming_rules.time: all *_at and event_time timestamp instants use UTC; trade_date belongs to the exchange calendar; never infer timestamp precision
naming_rules.array_order: only meaningful when the contract defines it; rank and event ordinal explicit
naming_rules.foreign_keys: same stable identifier at API/domain/database boundary; no duplicate stock/security ID namespaces

field_status_definitions.observed: a source fact after reversible normalization; retain source lineage
field_status_definitions.derived: an explicitly specified computation over versioned observations, never a newly invented source fact
field_status_definitions.missing: the field applies but was not available
field_status_definitions.invalid: the source supplied a value that violates its field/type/unit/semantic contract
field_status_definitions.not_applicable: field has no meaning for this instrument/event/context under a named policy
field_status_definitions.disputed: aligned independent observations conflict beyond the versioned tolerance

missing_value_rules: SQL NULL is never implicitly zero. Zero is a valid observation only when supported by the source and session/instrument semantics.
Canonical nulls require field_quality status and reason. Invalid original values remain in immutable raw objects.
Alternate source completion remains observed with value_origin=alternate_source, source ID, raw reference and alignment trace.
Model estimates are derived in a separate namespace and cannot overwrite OHLC, amount, volume, published time, company facts or source evidence.

canonical_market_fields.name: price_raw
canonical_market_fields.meaning: generic unadjusted price; concrete bars use open_price_raw/high_price_raw/low_price_raw/close_price_raw; quotes use last_price_raw

canonical_market_fields.name: volume_shares
canonical_market_fields.meaning: interval or cumulative meaning must be declared by contract; cumulative intraday snapshots cannot be appended and summed as interval bars

canonical_market_fields.name: turnover_amount_cny
canonical_market_fields.meaning: never mix thousands of yuan with yuan

canonical_market_fields.name: exchange_reference_price_raw
canonical_market_fields.meaning: exchange adjusted previous reference price when the source states that definition; not the prior bar raw close

canonical_market_fields.name: adjustment_mode
canonical_market_fields.meaning: raw and adjusted datasets are separate; adjustment factor version is required for adjusted datasets

canonical_market_fields.name: field_quality
canonical_market_fields.meaning: per canonical path: status, raw_value, raw_unit, origin/source/raw_object refs, conversion, mapping_version, precision, reason and optional conflict references

domains.name: core.price_raw
constraints: CHECK (value > 0 AND CAST(value AS text) NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity'))

domains.name: core.nonnegative_amount
constraints: CHECK (value >= 0 AND CAST(value AS text) NOT IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity'))
